a.speaker: rudy
a.text: Is this thing on? Miss Moreno? It's Rudy. From the door. I'm in the green room closet. Don't ask.

b.speaker: rudy
b.text: Security's everywhere, the stagehands have pipes, and Mr. Kowalski is on the Cadillac in the middle of the stage. He's been polishing a flamethrower for an hour.

c.speaker: rudy
c.text: The control room's up the east side. And the sprinklers really are fake. I checked. I'm a professional.

e.speaker: rudy
e.text: Copy. Closet. Great. Love the closet.
